title: 第5352章 增不增援第5351章 人族防区
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙归一诀陆沉第5352章增不增援（..la）人族虚神的高层们正紧急的聚在一起，商议人族防区的防御问题，以及如何应付突变事件。
七条防线遭到突而其来的攻击，七个哨所群皆有部分沦陷，人族的驻军损失有点大，这是一千年来少见的事件。
一般防区有战事发生，也是一条防线遭到攻击，一个哨所群会遭到入侵，这才是常态。
而不是七条防线同时受到袭击，七个哨所群遭到入侵，这是反常态的。
曙光哨所的防区分成六个，人族只是其中之一，还不是范围最大的防区，因为最大的那个防区在魔族手上。
人族的防区设有几十条防线，每一条防线至少有数百万兵力，且全是依靠一个个哨所来防御，并不是那么容易打下来的。
同时攻击七条防线，对方所动用的兵力绝对不少，没有数千万兵力根本打不了，这还是最低要求而已。
一旦人族从其他防线上抽调兵力，然后全力支援过来，对方那数千兵力将不堪一击。
但问题是，人族也不敢随便抽调其他防线的兵力，以防兵力抽出太多，而中了调虎离山之计。
向诸族请援的话，诸族也有自己的防区要守，不一定会抽调兵力过来，多半是由人族自己解决。
当然也有例外，若人族防区遭到全面攻击，所有防线即将保不住的时侯，诸族才会全力支援。
那是到了唇寒齿亡的地步，一个种族的防区失守，就会连累其他种族的防区，所以诸族不会坐视不管，包括魔族都会出兵支援。
但现在不是遭到全面进行，而是部分防线被攻击，战况还相当紧急，这才让人族的高层们感到头疼。
“对方的进攻规模不大也不小，既不全面进攻，也不只打一条防线，他们到底想干什么？”
“这种情况真是千年一遇，七条防线遭到的攻击很猛，但还能勉强撑得住，就是不知能够撑到什么时侯？”
“还是得增援过去吧，不然七条防线崩了，剩下的防线就会遭到巨大影响，到时侯也会有其他防线陆续崩溃的。”
“刚才不是说过了，一旦我们抽了其他防线的兵力，正好中了对方的调虎离山之计，那岂不是情况更糟糕？”
“那怎么办，眼睁睁看着有防线被打穿，我们还是坐视不管？”
“不然呢，抽兵力增援，其他防线的兵力就少了，那更加危险，更容易被对方突袭击破。”
“该死的，要是只打我们一两条防线，甚至是三条防线，我们都能抽一点兵力过去，也足够守住防线不失，可七条防线战事同时发生，那就不好办了。”

大部分的人族高层纷纷发表意见，却是争论多、统一少，还在增不增援方面上吵得不可开交。
没怎么说话的，甚至沉默不言的，只有少部分高层人士，也是在人族虚神之中地位比较高那几位。
比如人族虚神的领头人关山玉，以及人族的两位虚神强者庞义和韩奉，就一直在思考着什么，几乎没有作声。
直至，一众高层争不下去了，也争到没声音，这才轮到没说话的人开口。
关山玉扫了众人一眼，然后清了清嗓子，这才开始说话：“你们争完了吧，吵够了吧，没人再说话，那就轮到我来说了。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 5352 of Jiulong Returning to Unity by Lu Chen Chapter 5352: Reinforcement or not (..la) The senior leaders of the human race's virtual gods are gathering together urgently to discuss the defense issues of the human race's defense zone and how to deal with sudden events.
Seven lines of defense were suddenly attacked, and all seven outpost groups were partially destroyed. The human garrison suffered heavy losses. This was a rare event in a thousand years.
Generally, when a war breaks out in a defense area, a line of defense will be attacked and a group of outposts will be invaded. This is normal.
Instead of seven defense lines being attacked at the same time, seven outpost groups were invaded, which was abnormal.
The defense area of ​​Dawn Outpost is divided into six, and the human race is only one of them. It is not the largest defense area, because the largest defense area is in the hands of the demon race.
The human race's defense zone has dozens of defense lines. Each line of defense has at least millions of troops, and they are all defended by outposts. They are not easy to defeat.
To attack seven lines of defense at the same time, the opponent will definitely use a lot of troops. It is impossible to defeat them without tens of millions of troops. This is still the minimum requirement.
Once the human race draws troops from other lines of defense and then comes with full support, the opponent's thousands of troops will be vulnerable.
But the problem is that the human race does not dare to randomly allocate troops from other defense lines, lest they draw too many troops and fall into the trap of diverting the tiger away from the mountain.
If you ask for help from various tribes, each tribe also has its own defense zone to defend, and they may not necessarily send troops over. Most of them will be solved by the human race themselves.
Of course, there are exceptions. If the human race's defense area is fully attacked and all defense lines are about to be undefeated, all races will give full support.
It was a desperate situation. If the defense area of ​​one race was lost, the defense areas of other races would be affected. Therefore, all races would not sit idly by and do nothing, including the demons, who would send troops to support.
But now it is not being fully attacked, but part of the defense line is being attacked, and the battle situation is still quite urgent. This is causing headaches for the senior leaders of the human race.
"The opponent's attack is neither large nor small. It neither attacks comprehensively nor only one line of defense. What exactly do they want to do?"
"This situation really happens once in a thousand years. The seven lines of defense were attacked very fiercely, but they can still hold on. I just don't know how long they can hold on?"
"We still need reinforcements, otherwise if the seven lines of defense collapse, the remaining lines of defense will be greatly affected, and other lines of defense will also collapse one after another."
"Didn't I just say that once we draw out the troops from other defense lines and fall into the opponent's plan to divert the tiger away from the mountain, wouldn't the situation be even worse?"
"Then what should we do? We just sit back and do nothing while we watch the line of defense being breached?"
"Otherwise, if we draw in troops for reinforcements, there will be fewer troops on other lines of defense, which will be more dangerous and easier for the opponent to break through."
"Damn it, if we only attack one or two lines of defense, or even three lines of defense, we can send some troops to go over, which is enough to hold the line of defense without losing. But if seven lines of defense are fighting at the same time, it will be difficult to handle."
Most of the top human race officials expressed their opinions, but there was a lot of debate and little unity, and they were still arguing over whether to increase reinforcements.
There were only a few high-level people who did not speak much, or even remained silent, and they were also those with higher status among the human race's virtual gods.
For example, Guan Shanyu, the leader of the Human Race's Virtual God, and Pang Yi and Han Feng, the two powerful Human Race's Virtual Gods, have been thinking about something and almost remained silent.
It wasn't until the high-level officials couldn't argue anymore and there was no sound left, that it was the turn of the silent person to speak.
Guan Shanyu glanced at everyone, then cleared his throat, and then started to speak: "You guys are done arguing. Enough arguing. No one is talking anymore, so it's my turn to speak."
